common.reasonHint: 5 to 500 characters. Stored in the audit log.

home.title: SAMBO Digital
home.lead: The whole tournament in one system: from regulations to the results archive.

login.title: Sign in
login.totpHint: 6 digits or a recovery code like XXXXX-XXXXX

register.title: Sign up
register.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. Common passwords are rejected.
register.acceptTerms: I accept the terms of use and the personal data processing policy
register.sentBody: If the address can be used, we have sent a confirmation link. It is valid for 24 hours.

verify.title: Email confirmation
verify.failed: The link is invalid or expired. Sign up again or reset your password.

forgot.title: Password recovery
forgot.body: Enter your account email and we will send a password reset link.
forgot.sent: If an account with this address exists, the email is on its way. The link is valid for 1 hour.

reset.title: New password
reset.done: Password changed and all sessions ended. Sign in with the new password.

invite.title: Organization invitation
invite.needLogin: Sign in with the email address the invitation was sent to and open the link again.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.noOrganizations: You are not a member of any organization yet.
dashboard.totpWarning: Platform roles require two-factor authentication. Enable it in your profile — without it administrator rights do not apply.
dashboard.nextPhases: Next phases: competitions and entries, weigh-in, draw, refereeing.

users.title: Users
users.name: Name
users.blockBody: All sessions of the user end immediately.
users.grantHint: A platform role can only be granted to a user with two-factor authentication enabled.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.createHint: An organization without a parent, or created without rights on the parent, goes to review.
organizations.name: Full name
organizations.slugHint: Latin letters, digits and hyphens. Leave empty to generate automatically.
organizations.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 2 MB
organizations.legalHidden: Legal details are visible only to those who can edit the organization.
organizations.inviteHint: The invitation is emailed and valid for 7 days. You cannot grant a role wider than your own.
organizations.pendingNotice: The organization is under review. It becomes visible to everyone once the parent organization or a platform administrator activates it.
organizations.managerEmailHint: The manager will receive an invitation at this address. You register the organization on their behalf and do not join it yourself. You can leave it empty and invite later.

settings.title: System settings
settings.bannerHint: Leave both fields empty to remove the banner.
settings.emptyMeansNone: Leave empty if there is no address.

account.title: My profile
account.totpScan: Add the key to an authenticator app, then enter the code.
account.recoveryBody: Store the codes in a safe place. Each code works once if you lose access to the app. They will not be shown again.

person.title: My details
person.hint: Full name, date of birth and gender are needed for coaches, referees and legal guardians. Visible only to those entitled to see them.
person.duplicate: A person with the same name and date of birth already exists. If it is you, ask your coach or club to link that record to your account.

fields.password_leaked: This password is too common — choose another
fields.invalid_slug: Latin letters, digits and hyphens, 3–80 characters
fields.invalid_url: Website must start with http:// or https://
fields.invalid_region: The region does not belong to the selected country
fields.invalid_file: The file cannot be used: upload it again
fields.reason_too_short: Reason must be at least 5 characters
fields.not_allowed: This field is available only when creating an organization with platform or parent-organization authority
fields.manager_is_creator: Enter the manager address, not your own
fields.birth_date_out_of_range: Date of birth is out of range (an athlete must be 5 to 25 years old)
fields.coach_profile_required: Fill in your details in your account first to become a coach
fields.not_a_club: Choose a club or sports school
fields.coach_not_in_club: This coach does not work at the athlete's club
fields.coach_not_found: No coach with this email at the club
fields.guardian_is_athlete: An athlete cannot be their own guardian
fields.before_current_primary: The date is before the current primary club started
fields.before_valid_from: The end date is before the start date
fields.invalid_document: The document does not belong to this athlete
fields.template_not_active: This consent version is not in force
fields.user_or_person_required: Specify an account or person details
fields.person_required: The user has not filled in their details yet
fields.not_member: The user is not a member of the organization
fields.invalid_weight_category: The weight category is not from this group
fields.duplicate_in_file: The same athlete appears earlier in the file
fields.format_ranges_invalid: Participant ranges must be contiguous from 2 and end open
fields.same_athlete: A record cannot be merged with itself
fields.parameters_or_base_required: Specify parameters or a base version
fields.invalid_name: Letters, space, hyphen and apostrophe only

errors.VERSION_REQUIRED: Refresh the page and try again.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else has changed this data. Refresh the page and try again.
errors.INVALID_CURSOR: The list is outdated, refresh the page.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: This file type is not supported.
errors.FILE_CONTENT_MISMATCH: The file content does not match its type. Upload another file.
errors.TOKEN_EXPIRED: The link is invalid or expired.
errors.REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID: Session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED: Session ended for security reasons. Please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
errors.CSRF_TOKEN_INVALID: Session is outdated. Refresh the page.
errors.ACCOUNT_BLOCKED: The account is blocked. Contact the administrator.
errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email using the link we sent.
errors.INVALID_TRANSITION: This status change is not available.
errors.TRANSITION_PRECONDITIONS_NOT_MET: Conditions for this action are not met.
errors.ORGANIZATION_HIERARCHY_CYCLE: An organization cannot be subordinate to its own descendant.
errors.ROLE_SCOPE_MISMATCH: This role cannot be granted in an organization.
errors.ROLE_EXCEEDS_GRANTOR: You cannot grant a role wider than your own.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE: Service temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.NETWORK: No connection to the server. Check your network.
errors.UNKNOWN: The action could not be completed.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED: Retry the action: the request has no idempotency key.
errors.MESSENGER_DATA_INVALID: Messenger data could not be verified.
errors.NODE_CREDENTIALS_INVALID: The venue node is not authorized.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request was already made with different data.
errors.EXPECTED_SEQ_MISMATCH: Data is outdated. Refresh the page.
errors.WRITE_AUTHORITY_ELSEWHERE: The tournament is currently run on the venue node: changes in the cloud are unavailable.

errors.DOCUMENT_ALREADY_REVIEWED: The document has already been reviewed. Upload a new one to correct it.

athletes.title: Athletes
athletes.listHint: Athletes of your clubs. Other clubs' data is not shown.
athletes.searchPlaceholder: Last name, first name or number
athletes.empty: No athletes yet. Add an athlete or import a list from a file.
athletes.name: Full name
athletes.createHint: Before creating, the system looks for similar athletes in all clubs to avoid duplicates.
athletes.noClubs: There are no clubs where you may perform this action.
athletes.coachProfileRequired: To become the athlete's coach, fill in your details (name, date of birth) in your account.
athletes.coachSelfHint: You are the coach by default.
athletes.duplicatesHint: Check whether this is the same person. If they moved from another club, register a transfer instead of a new record.
athletes.createAnyway: It is a different person — create
athletes.archiveHint: The athlete disappears from club lists; competition history is kept.
athletes.mergeHint: If this is a duplicate of another record, merge them: ranks, guardians, consents and documents move to the main record.
athletes.mergeWarning: This record will be removed and its data moved to the main one. This cannot be undone.
athletes.transferHint: The current primary club ends the day before the transfer date.
athletes.notFoundHint: There is no such record or the athlete belongs to another club: other clubs’ data is not shown.

guardians.title: Legal guardians
guardians.noneForMinor: The athlete is a minor: add a legal guardian — they give consent to data processing.
guardians.emailHint: Optional: an invitation to the personal account is sent to this address.
guardians.added: Guardian added. Verify them once you see a document or an application.
guardians.addedInvited: Guardian added; an invitation was sent to {email}. Verify them once you see a document or an application.

consents.title: Consents
consents.guardianNotVerified: Consents are given by a legal guardian after the coach or club verifies them. An adult athlete gives consents personally.
consents.revokeHint: Without consent to data processing the athlete cannot enter new competitions. A reason is optional.
consents.agree: I have read the text and give my consent
consents.paperHint: Upload a scan of the signed consent (PDF, JPG or PNG).
consents.needVerifiedGuardian: For a minor, a verified guardian signs — verify the guardian first.

documents.title: Documents
documents.rejectHint: The uploader will see the reason: say what to fix.
documents.expirationHint: If the document expires — e.g. a medical certificate.
documents.chooseType: Choose a document type to upload a file.
documents.competitionHint: ID of the competition the document is for: the competition secretary reviews it. Picking from a list arrives with competitions (Phase 4).

imports.title: Import athletes
imports.hint: Upload a list of athletes from CSV or Excel: rows are checked and duplicates found before anything is saved.
imports.rule1: The first row holds headers: Last name, First name, Middle name, Date of birth, Gender, Rank, Assigned on, Order number, Coach email (Russian or English column names).
imports.rule2: Dates as DD.MM.YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD; gender M or F; up to 1000 rows.
imports.rule3: Nothing is saved until you review the preview and confirm the import.
imports.parsingHint: Checking rows and looking for duplicates. This usually takes a few seconds.

fileErrors.FILE_UNREADABLE: The file could not be read. Save it as CSV (UTF-8) or XLSX.
fileErrors.EMPTY_FILE: The file has no athlete rows.
fileErrors.MISSING_COLUMNS: Required columns are missing: last name, first name, date of birth, gender.
fileErrors.TOO_MANY_ROWS: Too many rows: up to 1000 at a time.

imports.summary: File “{file}”: {total} rows, {valid} valid, {errors} with errors, {duplicates} possible duplicates.

children.title: My athletes
children.hint: Children you are the legal guardian of, and your own athlete record.
children.noPerson: Fill in your details in your account — the coach uses them to link you to the child.
children.emptyHint: Ask the coach to add you as a guardian and send an invitation to your email.
children.waitVerification: The coach or club has not yet verified you as the legal guardian. Details and consents open after verification.

guardianInvite.title: Legal guardian invitation
guardianInvite.success: Done: your account is linked to the guardian record.
guardianInvite.needLogin: Sign in or register with the email the invitation was sent to.
guardianInvite.wrongAccount: The invitation was sent to a different email. Sign in with that address and verify it.

coaches.title: Coaches
coaches.hint: Club coaches: only they and the club manager see the club's athletes.
coaches.fromMembers: Organization member with the Coach role
coaches.memberHint: The member must fill in their details (name, date of birth) in their account.
coaches.duplicate: A person with the same name and date of birth already exists. Check whether it is them.
coaches.createAnyway: It is a different person — create

referees.title: Referees
referees.hint: Register of referees and referee categories.
referees.userIdHint: If the referee has an account, enter its ID (Users section). Otherwise fill in the details below.

catalog.categoriesHint: Reference data for competition regulations. A competition copies categories from a template — changes here do not affect existing competitions.
catalog.codeHint: Latin letters, digits and _, e.g. U14.
catalog.templateItems: Groups (all weight categories of the group)
catalog.needWeights: Add weight categories to age groups first.

rulesets.title: Rule sets
rulesets.hint: Match durations, scores, penalties, tie-breakers and formats. A competition pins a published version.
rulesets.name: Name
rulesets.noVersions: No versions yet: create the first one — it is prefilled with sample parameters.
rulesets.immutable: A published version cannot be changed. Create a new version to change the rules.
rulesets.parametersHint: Validated on save; errors show the field path.

consentTemplates.title: Consent texts
consentTemplates.hint: A published version is immutable: each consent refers to the text version the person saw.
consentTemplates.immutable: A published text cannot be edited. Create a new version.
consentTemplates.bodyHint: At least 50 characters. Markdown is supported.
